snippet.title: Sincerely, Your Diary - Free Demo Out Now on Steam
snippet.description:
The free demo of Sincerely, Your Diary is out now on Steam. Full release: November 27.

A quiet autumn evening in a small seaside town, the soft flicker of a monitor, drizzle outside the window, and your favorite tracks playing through your headphones. A message suddenly pops up, breaking the familiar calm: a simple "hi" from a stranger who found you in someone else's photo. What begins as a casual conversation to pass the time gradually becomes a fragile thread connecting two completely different worlds...
